description: The files attached to an item, including everything that came in through a request_file_upload link, each with a download URL that is signed and short lived (mint a fresh one by calling again). Also lists the upload links on the item and how many files each has taken, which is how to tell whether the person you asked has delivered.

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: list_uploaded_files
